login.title: Milkbasket login
login.saved_status: A login is saved, encrypted. It renews itself with its refresh token; paste a new one here only if Milkbasket asks you to sign in again.
login.help: Sign in on milkbasket.com in a private window. Press F12, open Network, reload, and find the refreshAuthToken request (or the sign-in response): copy refreshToken (and authorization, without “Bearer”). Then close the window without logging out. The app owns that login from now on: using it in a browser again would cancel it.
login.refreshHint: Required. Kept encrypted; never shown again.
login.authHint: The authorization value. Leave empty and the app gets one with the refresh token.
login.saved: Login saved, encrypted. It renews itself from now on.
login.invalid: Paste the token as copied: letters, numbers and + / =, no spaces.
